2608.06549.title: TradeVerse: A Longitudinal Benchmark of Political Negotiation in International Trade
2608.06549.paper_summary: LLMs are increasingly being applied to tasks involving institutional and political texts, but existing benchmarks evaluate them on isolated documents or single tasks. In realpolitik, negotiations are longitudinal data, where participating parties can align or argue over multiple iterations and each turn is an outcome of the previous turns, hence, understanding one turn requires tracking everything before it. We introduce TradeVerse, a benchmark built from the World Trade Organisation (WTO) specific trade concerns, where member states challenge one another and exchange arguments over multiple rounds, sometimes for years. We, in TradeVerse, reconstruct minutes of $1170$ meetings, spanning across 5 groups and $89$ product groups and define three tasks: first, the system has to analyze the longitudinal meeting records and predict the harmonized system codes (HS chapters) of the products under discussion in the particular meeting, second, we examine whether the system, upon analyzing the anonymized content of the meeting, can guess the name of the responding country and third, we ask the system to play the role of the responding country and provide the statement for the very last round. All labels are recovered directly from the proceedings, requiring no manual annotation. Our experiments highlight the challenges these tasks pose for current LLMs. To the best of our knowledge, TradeVerseis the first benchmark to investigate potential of LLMs in understanding longitudinal political trade negotiations.
2608.06549.paper_summary_zh: LLMs 正在越來越多地應用於涉及機構和政治文本的任務，但現有的基準評估它們僅基於孤立的文件或單一任務。在現實政治中，談判是縱向數據，參與方可以在多次迭代中對齊或爭論，每次回合都是前一次回合的結果，因此，理解一個回合需要追蹤之前的所有內容。 我們介紹 TradeVerse，一個基於世界貿易組織（WTO）特定貿易關切的基準，在這裡成員國彼此挑戰並在多輪中交換論點，有時長達數年。我們在 TradeVerse 中重建了 $1170$ 次會議的會議紀錄，涵蓋了 5 個小組和 $89$ 個產品小組，並定義了三個任務：首先，系統必須分析縱向會議記錄，並預測在特定會議中討論的產品的統一編碼系統（HS 章節）代碼；第二，我們檢查系統在分析會議的匿名內容後，是否能猜出回應國的名稱；第三，我們要求系統扮演回應國的角色，並提供最後一輪的聲明。所有標籤都是直接從會議紀錄中恢復的，無需手動註釋。我們的實驗突顯了這些任務對當前 LLMs 所帶來的挑戰。據我們所知，TradeVerse 是第一個調查 LLMs 在理解縱向政治貿易談判潛力的基準。
2608.06549.author: Debodeep Banerjee et.al.
